changes: New: Plinko can now drop multiple balls at once — pick 1, 2, 5, or 10, each at your set bet price, with a live 'Total stake' readout. Every ball runs its own fully independent random walk (staggered slightly so a multi-ball drop cascades down the board rather than every ball moving in lockstep) — RTP is unaffected by ball count, only the variance per round changes.
Fixed: the ball was settling near the top edge of its landed slot instead of centred in it — recalculated the resting position against the actual slot band height.
Polish: payout slots redesigned as proper glossy pills (full rounded capsules with a highlight sweep) instead of flat rounded rectangles, with a soft glow added to the rare 180x edge tier.
